findings.title: Ordinary duplicate receipts are NOOP success, not a transaction error
evidence: source/modules/core/04-channel/keeper/packet.go:199-206 unordered receipt found returns types.ErrNoOpMsg
source/modules/core/04-channel/keeper/packet.go:224-229 ordered sequence < nextSequenceRecv returns types.ErrNoOpMsg
source/modules/core/keeper/msg_server.go:439-441 maps ErrNoOpMsg to MsgRecvPacketResponse{Result: NOOP}, nil and returns before OnRecvPacket
findings.statement: P26 replay-after-finality cannot be represented as an invented executor error for ordinary IBC duplicates. Task 27.1 must freeze an explicit observation mapping or select a different workflow that actually refuses.

findings.title: Earlier guards can refuse before the NOOP classification
evidence: packet.go:113-115 channel not OPEN
packet.go:147-148 timeout elapsed on receive is an actual error
packet.go:154-160 proof failure is an actual error
packet.go:190-191 sequence < recvStartSequence returns ErrPacketReceived
packet.go:234-237 ordered sequence != nextSequenceRecv returns ErrPacketSequenceOutOfOrder
findings.statement: Do not claim every malformed, expired, or stale replay reaches NOOP. Packets below recvStartSequence are ErrPacketReceived. Ordered future sequence is another actual refusal.

findings.title: Ack and timeout consume the source packet commitment; timeout checks maturity and remote non-receipt
evidence: packet.go:437 deletePacketCommitment on successful ack
timeout.go:68-71 timeout not reached is an actual error
timeout.go:75-81 empty local commitment returns ErrNoOpMsg
timeout.go:91-110 ordered next-sequence proof versus unordered VerifyPacketReceiptAbsence
timeout.go:135 timeoutExecuted deletes commitment and closes ordered channels
findings.statement: Successful acknowledgement deletes the sending-chain commitment before the application ack callback. Timeout requires verified remote non-receipt and maturity at the supplied proof height or timestamp. Missing local commitment alone is not the entire timeout guard.

findings.title: ICS-20 compensation is conditional and origin-dependent
evidence: relay.go:220-224 successful Acknowledgement_Result returns nil without token movement
relay.go:225-228 error ack refunds
relay.go:235-242 timeout refunds
relay.go:261-262 refund rejects blocked sender
relay.go:277-291 prefixed denom remints; otherwise unescrows
relay.go:316-321 UnescrowCoin can fail
findings.statement: Do not claim unconditional compensation or refund success. Successful ack does not refund. Error ack and timeout refund by unescrow or voucher remint according to asset origin. Refund can fail, including blocked sender and unescrow failure.

findings.title: Verified misbehaviour freezes the client and returns success without refunding packets
evidence: client.go:60-74 VerifyClientMessage, CheckForMisbehaviour, UpdateStateOnMisbehaviour, return nil
update.go:211-217 FrozenHeight assigned without re-checking misbehaviour
client_state.go:81-88 frozen status precedes expiry
keeper.go:343-344 VerifyMembership requires Active
packet.go:61-62 SendPacket requires Active
client.go:118-145 RecoverClient can restore a non-Active subject from an Active substitute
findings.statement: Challenge/finality freeze is not automatic per-message compensation. While frozen, membership proofs fail, so recv/timeout/ack verification is blocked. RecoverClient is a selected unfreeze path and does not refund pending packets. Later contracts must keep this path explicit.

findings.title: Local SDK cache and transaction boundaries are not remote rollback
evidence: msg_server.go:433-451 RecvPacket uses CacheContext; first writeFn commits receipt before the application callback
msg_server.go:452-458 unsuccessful application ack discards callback cache but keeps the already-written receipt
msg_server.go:497-516 TimeoutPacket writeFn then OnTimeoutPacket on the parent context
findings.statement: Core callbacks and SDK cache/transaction commit boundaries must not be confused with synchronous rollback of a remote chain. A later P26 model must not assume the counterparty is undone.

findings.title: README refund wording says blocked recipient; refund source checks sender
evidence: p26-ibc-source-preparation/README.md sentence on refund failure
relay.go:261 IsBlockedAddr(sender) in refundPacketTokens
relay.go:137 IsBlockedAddr(receiver) in OnRecvPacket
findings.statement: The packet README says refund can fail including for a blocked recipient. The refund function rejects a blocked sender. Receive rejects a blocked receiver. This is an editorial imprecision, not an identity mismatch. Task 27.1 should pin the actual sender guard.

findings.title: TimeoutOnClose is an additional compensation path and is not a navigation anchor
evidence: timeout.go:196-202 TimeoutOnClose empty commitment returns ErrNoOpMsg
msg_server.go:551-553 MsgTimeoutOnCloseResponse NOOP
source-navigation.json has timeout-noop-api for MsgTimeoutResponse only
findings.statement: TimeoutOnClose can compensate without timeout elapsed, after proving the counterparty channel is closed and non-receipt. Ordinary TimeoutOnClose duplicates are also NOOP. This path is in the selected source and must remain available to 27.1.

findings.title: Source declarations are not installed runtime identities; no import closure
evidence: source/go.mod module github.com/cosmos/ibc-go/v11, go 1.26.5, cosmos-sdk v0.55.0, cometbft v0.40.0
source-manifest.json import_closure_claimed false, compiler_runtime_dependencies_resolved false, source_execution false
archive has 1890 regular members; only 33 selected Git blobs were identity-checked
findings.statement: Go 1.26.5, ibc-go v11, SDK v0.55.0 and CometBFT v0.40.0 were not installed or executed. Oracle, custody, legal, sequencing, finality and proof authenticity remain explicit future contract obligations.
